title: Chapter 6495: Such A Worthless Son

Chapter 6495: Such A Worthless Son

Chapter 6495: Such A Worthless Son

“You won’t be the one to decide our fate.” Seventy-two Origin Ancestor shouted.

“Three-eyed and his wife were capable talents, how did they birth such a worthless son?” Li Qiye stared at him and said.

Seventy-two’s face became ugly and was filled with murderous intent. The casual remark touched his insecurity so he barked: “Who are you?!”

“That matters not.” Li Qiye waved and said: “I will spare you if you leave out of respect for your parents.”

“Hahaha!” His craziness exploded. As an eternal ancestor, he didn’t need his parents’ remnant goodwill for protection. He was substantially stronger than either at this point.

“I don’t need your sentiment, let’s see who will survive today!” He lost all sense of rationality since his parents were his trauma.

Trinity and the others, on the other hand, remained calm. They stared at the supreme woman, awaiting her guidance.

“We have no feud with you, Sir. A fight to the death is unnecessary, so please take what you wish outside of the three springs.” She said.

“I don’t need anything. Last warning, leave.” Li Qiye waved his hand dismissively as if he had absolute control over their fate.

The primal ancestors weren’t used to being treated with disdain, hence their rising anger.

“Sir, there is always a higher heaven and a greater man...” Her eyes turned cold.

“I am that higher heaven and the greater man.” Li Qiye said: “You are Xian Chengtian’s disciple, correct? You may leave and deliver a message that I’ll be taking his life.”

Listeners took a deep breath upon hearing this. Everyone knew Xian Chengtian was only one step beneath the immortals. Who could kill him?

All eyes were on Li Qiye but none could match him to a particular immortal.

“I was wrong then, there is an existing feud.” She realized this was more than just a competition over the dream world.

“My patience ran out, it’s time to bring out the coffins.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Bring it.” Seventy-two was eager for a fight and hated Li Qiye for some reason despite this being their first meeting.

“Buzz.” He opened all his wings, allowing his primal anima to enter a frenzy and absorb the endless power of life from Paramount’s source.

His demand caused the power to flow like a tsunami. Trinity and the others had no choice but to accept it since they were all connected.

“Everlasting!” They roared as their power surged.

“A fight it is, Sir.” The woman thought this was a rare opportunity to muster the true potential of the two springs. More importantly, she hoped to rid her master of a mighty foe.

“Very well!” Skyraiser, Nine-turns, and Eight-armed became excited.

The power of Paragon suddenly flowed to them without their command, the same with Paramount’s power. Was this due to their excitement?

This power level was beyond what they had when they faced Gold Village previously.

“Again!” The ancestor of all gods had a golden form now. This form belonged to the giant of Gold Village but somehow, it appeared on Paragon’s avatar.

Divine rings attached themselves to the avatar and transformed into divine armor. Skyraiser’s group enjoyed an unprecedented state, feeling they were one with Paragon.

“Immemorial True God.” The avatar whispered, believing this to be a form of the truth.

The primal ancestors sensed their current realm clearly - supreme.

“This is it...” They were ecstatic and became more determined. These springs of Heavenly Sin could turn them into supreme overlords.

Meanwhile, the springs never stopped sending more power to fuel them and stimulate their primal anima. Their bodies were fused with the dream realm; its powers coursed through every inch of their flesh. They believed this was a path to everlasting life.
